_readme: Draft knowledge base for Ustaad AI (split AC). Only entries with verified=true should be sent to the model. verified=true means the text was read on an official manufacturer support page on checked_on, NOT that it was checked against your specific model manual. Spot-check before the demo. Do not add codes from aggregator sites.

entries.model_series: LG room/split ACs; codes differ by model
entries.meaning: Communication problem between the indoor and outdoor units
probable_causes: Temporary communication or power error
Faulty wiring or a loose connector
Problem with the main circuit board
If it appeared right after installation or relocation: loose connection or refrigerant leak from installation
checks: Power-cycle: unplug or switch off the circuit breaker, wait 5 minutes, restore power
If it appeared right after installation or relocation, contact the installer
If the error persists after the power cycle, service is needed

sources.title: LG India - [LG Air Conditioner] Guide to Error Codes
LG Sri Lanka - error code troubleshooting

entries.model_series: LG room/split ACs; codes differ by model
entries.meaning: Drainage problem: indoor unit drain malfunction, or condensate tank too full
probable_causes: Indoor unit drain malfunction
Condensate tank too full
Window and portable types: more condensate on rainy or humid days
checks: Empty the condensate tank (window and portable types)
Power-cycle: unplug or switch off the circuit breaker, wait 5 minutes, restore power
If it happens often even on dry days, the unit needs inspection

entries.meaning: Operating-mode conflict between units (2-in-1 or multi-unit systems)
probable_causes: Standing and wall-mount units set to different modes, for example one cooling and one heating
checks: Set all units to heating, or all to cooling/dehumidification (cooling and dehumidification cannot run together with heating)

entries.meaning: Overheating protection: outdoor unit too hot in cooling mode, or indoor unit too hot in heating mode
probable_causes: Cooling: outdoor unit heat cannot escape (poor ventilation, items piled around it)
Heating: poor air intake, often a clogged or dirty indoor filter
checks: Clear obstacles around the outdoor unit and improve ventilation (an air guide can help)
Clean the indoor unit filter
CH61 does not clear by itself: power-cycle to clear it

entries.model_series: Samsung split ACs; first letter E or C depends on model year
entries.meaning: Indoor fan motor entered protection mode
probable_causes: Intermittent: input voltage above the normal range (overload voltage protection around 290-310 V); recovers once voltage is back below about 290 V
Continuous (returns within 10 seconds of restart): defective fan motor or printed board assembly (PBA)
checks: Turn the AC off, wait a few seconds, turn it on, and watch whether C154 returns within 10 seconds
If it does not return: temporary voltage surge
If it repeats immediately: fan motor or PBA may be defective, get Samsung service
A voltage stabilizer can help where supply is unstable

checks: Check the signal cable between the indoor and outdoor units
Check the power supply to both units
